value.rationale: An exact maximal-silhouette law for an infinite natural family distinguishes joint antipodal visibility from the known one-apex marginal. The sharp factor-two asymptotic parity defect, all-maximizer height localization, and explicit finite-height formula provide structural information for random-shadow geometry, not simply a renamed case of the even law.
